en.text: The man knew Eve his wife. She conceived, and gave birth to Cain, and said, “I have gotten a man with the LORD’s help.”

footnotes.text: 4:1 or, lay with, or, had relations with

zhSimplified.text: 有一日，那人和他妻子同房，就怀孕，生了，便说：「耶和华使我得了一个男子。」

zhTraditional.text: 有一日，那人和他妻子同房，就懷孕，生了，便說：「耶和華使我得了一個男子。」

en.text: Again she gave birth, to Cain’s brother Abel. Abel was a keeper of sheep, but Cain was a tiller of the ground.

zhSimplified.text: 又生了的兄弟。是牧羊的；是种地的。

zhTraditional.text: 又生了的兄弟。是牧羊的；是種地的。

en.text: As time passed, Cain brought an offering to the LORD from the fruit of the ground.

zhSimplified.text: 有一日，拿地里的出产为供物献给耶和华；

zhTraditional.text: 有一日，拿地裏的出產為供物獻給耶和華；

en.text: Abel also brought some of the firstborn of his flock and of its fat. The LORD respected Abel and his offering,

zhSimplified.text: 也将他羊群中头生的和羊的脂油献上。耶和华看中了和他的供物，

zhTraditional.text: 也將他羊群中頭生的和羊的脂油獻上。耶和華看中了和他的供物，

en.text: but he didn’t respect Cain and his offering. Cain was very angry, and the expression on his face fell.

zhSimplified.text: 只是看不中和他的供物。就大大地发怒，变了脸色。

zhTraditional.text: 只是看不中和他的供物。就大大地發怒，變了臉色。

en.text: The LORD said to Cain, “Why are you angry? Why has the expression of your face fallen?

zhSimplified.text: 耶和华对说：「你为什么发怒呢？你为什么变了脸色呢？

zhTraditional.text: 耶和華對說：「你為甚麼發怒呢？你為甚麼變了臉色呢？

en.text: If you do well, won’t it be lifted up? If you don’t do well, sin crouches at the door. Its desire is for you, but you are to rule over it.”

zhSimplified.text: 你若行得好，岂不蒙悦纳？你若行得不好，罪就伏在门前。它必恋慕你，你却要制伏它。」

zhTraditional.text: 你若行得好，豈不蒙悅納？你若行得不好，罪就伏在門前。它必戀慕你，你卻要制伏它。」

en.text: Cain said to Abel, his brother, “Let’s go into the field.” While they were in the field, Cain rose up against Abel, his brother, and killed him.

zhSimplified.text: 与他兄弟说话；二人正在田间。起来打他兄弟，把他杀了。

zhTraditional.text: 與他兄弟說話；二人正在田間。起來打他兄弟，把他殺了。

en.text: The LORD said to Cain, “Where is Abel, your brother?” He said, “I don’t know. Am I my brother’s keeper?”

zhSimplified.text: 耶和华对说：「你兄弟在哪里？」他说：「我不知道！我岂是看守我兄弟的吗？」

zhTraditional.text: 耶和華對說：「你兄弟在哪裏？」他說：「我不知道！我豈是看守我兄弟的嗎？」

en.text: The LORD said, “What have you done? The voice of your brother’s blood cries to me from the ground.

zhSimplified.text: 耶和华说：「你做了什么事呢？你兄弟的血有声音从地里向我哀告。

zhTraditional.text: 耶和華說：「你做了甚麼事呢？你兄弟的血有聲音從地裏向我哀告。

en.text: Now you are cursed because of the ground, which has opened its mouth to receive your brother’s blood from your hand.

zhSimplified.text: 地开了口，从你手里接受你兄弟的血。现在你必从这地受咒诅。

zhTraditional.text: 地開了口，從你手裏接受你兄弟的血。現在你必從這地受咒詛。

en.text: From now on, when you till the ground, it won’t yield its strength to you. You will be a fugitive and a wanderer on the earth.”

zhSimplified.text: 你种地，地不再给你效力；你必流离飘荡在地上。」

zhTraditional.text: 你種地，地不再給你效力；你必流離飄蕩在地上。」

en.text: Cain said to the LORD, “My punishment is greater than I can bear.

zhSimplified.text: 对耶和华说：「我的刑罚太重，过于我所能当的。

zhTraditional.text: 對耶和華說：「我的刑罰太重，過於我所能當的。

en.text: Behold, you have driven me out today from the surface of the ground. I will be hidden from your face, and I will be a fugitive and a wanderer on the earth. Whoever finds me will kill me.”

zhSimplified.text: 你如今赶逐我离开这地，以致不见你面；我必流离飘荡在地上，凡遇见我的必杀我。」

zhTraditional.text: 你如今趕逐我離開這地，以致不見你面；我必流離飄蕩在地上，凡遇見我的必殺我。」

en.text: The LORD said to him, “Therefore whoever slays Cain, vengeance will be taken on him sevenfold.” The LORD appointed a sign for Cain, so that anyone finding him would not strike him.

zhSimplified.text: 耶和华对他说：「凡杀的，必遭报七倍。」耶和华就给立一个记号，免得人遇见他就杀他。

zhTraditional.text: 耶和華對他說：「凡殺的，必遭報七倍。」耶和華就給立一個記號，免得人遇見他就殺他。

en.text: Cain left the LORD’s presence, and lived in the land of Nod, east of Eden.

zhSimplified.text: 于是离开耶和华的面，去住在东边之地。

zhTraditional.text: 於是離開耶和華的面，去住在東邊之地。

en.text: Cain knew his wife. She conceived, and gave birth to Enoch. He built a city, and named the city after the name of his son, Enoch.

zhSimplified.text: 与妻子同房，他妻子就怀孕，生了。建造了一座城，就按着他儿子的名将那城叫做。

zhTraditional.text: 與妻子同房，他妻子就懷孕，生了。建造了一座城，就按着他兒子的名將那城叫做。

en.text: Irad was born to Enoch. Irad became the father of Mehujael. Mehujael became the father of Methushael. Methushael became the father of Lamech.

zhSimplified.text: 生；生；生；生。

zhTraditional.text: 生；生；生；生。

en.text: Lamech took two wives: the name of the first one was Adah, and the name of the second one was Zillah.

zhSimplified.text: 娶了两个妻：一个名叫，一个名叫。

zhTraditional.text: 娶了兩個妻：一個名叫，一個名叫。

en.text: Adah gave birth to Jabal, who was the father of those who dwell in tents and have livestock.

zhSimplified.text: 生；就是住帐棚、牧养牲畜之人的祖师。

zhTraditional.text: 生；就是住帳棚、牧養牲畜之人的祖師。

en.text: His brother’s name was Jubal, who was the father of all who handle the harp and pipe.

zhSimplified.text: 的兄弟名叫；他是一切弹琴吹箫之人的祖师。

zhTraditional.text: 的兄弟名叫；他是一切彈琴吹簫之人的祖師。

en.text: Zillah also gave birth to Tubal Cain, the forger of every cutting instrument of bronze and iron. Tubal Cain’s sister was Naamah.

zhSimplified.text: 又生了；他是打造各样铜铁利器的。的妹子是。

footnotes.text: - 4:22 或译：是铜匠铁匠的祖师

zhTraditional.text: 又生了；他是打造各樣銅鐵利器的。的妹子是。

footnotes.text: - 4:22 或譯：是銅匠鐵匠的祖師

en.text: Lamech said to his wives, Adah and Zillah, hear my voice. You wives of Lamech, listen to my speech, for I have slain a man for wounding me, a young man for bruising me.

zhSimplified.text: 对他两个妻子说： 、，听我的声音； 的妻子，细听我的话语： 。

footnotes.text: - 4:23 或译：我杀壮士却伤自己，我害幼童却损本身

zhTraditional.text: 對他兩個妻子說： 、，聽我的聲音； 的妻子，細聽我的話語： 。

footnotes.text: - 4:23 或譯：我殺壯士卻傷自己，我害幼童卻損本身

en.text: If Cain will be avenged seven times, truly Lamech seventy-seven times.”

zhSimplified.text: 若杀，遭报七倍， ，必遭报七十七倍。

zhTraditional.text: 若殺，遭報七倍， ，必遭報七十七倍。

en.text: Adam knew his wife again. She gave birth to a son, and named him Seth, saying, “for God has given me another child instead of Abel, for Cain killed him.”

zhSimplified.text: 又与妻子同房，她就生了一个儿子，起名叫，意思说：「 神另给我立了一个儿子代替，因为杀了他。」

zhTraditional.text: 又與妻子同房，她就生了一個兒子，起名叫，意思說：「上帝另給我立了一個兒子代替，因為殺了他。」

en.text: A son was also born to Seth, and he named him Enosh. At that time men began to call on the LORD’s name.

zhSimplified.text: 也生了一个儿子，起名叫。那时候，人才求告耶和华的名。

zhTraditional.text: 也生了一個兒子，起名叫。那時候，人才求告耶和華的名。
